summary: Fuel Database integration with Emissions tested successfully. All 12 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verification confirms: fuel dropdown grouped by category, auto-population of parameters (calorific value, emission factors, source), real-time emission calculation, Show Breakdown with formula details, Override Calorific Value and Override Density checkboxes. Emission creation with fuel database integration works correctly.

issues: Console warnings about HTML hydration errors (<span> in <option>/<select>/<optgroup>) - non-blocking but should be fixed for clean console

admin_login.details: Admin login with admin@ghg.com/admin123 works correctly, returns token and user info

tests: Each fuel contains required parameters: id, fuel_name, category, industry_sector, scope, calorific_value, calorific_value_unit, emission_factor_co2

emission_form_fuel_dropdown.details: Dropdown shows fuels grouped by category (Mobile Combustion, Stationary Combustion)

auto_populate_parameters.details: Selecting fuel auto-populates: category, calorific_value (43 MJ/kg), CO2 EF (74100 kg/TJ), source (IPCC 2006)

real_time_calculation.details: Quantity input updates calculated emissions in real-time. Example: 1000 units → 2750.1207 kg CO2e

show_breakdown_button.details: Shows detailed calculation: Energy Content = Qty × CV × Density × CF, Energy TJ, CO2/CH4/N2O emissions with GWP

override_calorific_value.details: Checkbox enables custom calorific value input, updates calculation accordingly

override_density.details: Checkbox enables custom density input, updates calculation accordingly

create_emission_with_fuel_db.details: Created emission with fuel database integration - toast confirms 'Emission record created successfully'

calculation_formula.details: Formula: qty × calorific × density × conversion × EF × GWP implemented correctly. Backend calculate_total_emissions function verified.

gwp_values.details: GWP values correct: CO2=1, CH4=28, N2O=265 (IPCC AR5)

super_admin_fuel_database.details: Super Admin can access Fuel Database page with full CRUD. Shows 4 fuels with all parameters.

critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: HTML hydration errors with <span> inside <option>/<select>/<optgroup> in Emissions.js - should use React fragment or proper element structure
seed_data_creation: Used existing fuels in database: Diesel, Natural Gas, Bituminous Coal, LPG. Created test emission record (cleaned up after test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fuel Database integration fully working. Backend tests cover: admin login, fuel database endpoint, emission creation with fuel params, override CV/density, CH4/N2O with GWP, custom fuel types, GWP values. Test file: test_fuel_database_integration.py. Super Admin Fuel Database page accessible at /fuel-database.
